To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the amount of silence and overlap in meetings are inversely proportional to each other, and that this information can be exploited to significantly improve the performance of a diarization system.
overlap detection based on silence distribution is useful for speaker diarization and that it is better to exclude segments with overlap from speaker diarization rather than to label them.

the proposed method for overlap detection improves speaker diarization performance in terms of F-score and that the proposed overlap detection method can be combined with the existing overlap handling methods for further improvement.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of silence information in overlap handling and its effect on the diarization performance.
the detection of overlap and its impact on speaker diarization.
the development of a new method for handling overlapping speech in speaker diarization.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed overlap detector and exclusion/labelling strategies are effective in handling overlap in diaries.
the proposed method for overlap detection and exclusion/labelling strategies based on it are able to significantly improve the diarization accuracy in case of meeting recordings.
the proposed method is able to significantly improve speaker diarization results on meeting recordings by handling overlapping speech.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
overlap detection can be significantly improved when the distribution of silence in a segment is considered in addition to acoustic information.
the proposed overlap detector is capable of detecting the presence of overlap and its duration.

the proposed overlap detector is able to identify the segments which are more likely to be overlap and hence the proposed exclusion and labelling techniques based on the overlap detector can be used to improve speaker diarization performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
silence information can be used to improve speaker diarization performance.
silence distribution in meeting speech is a good indicator for overlap occurrence.
overlap detection based on silence distribution is complementary to other features such as spectral and spatial information.
